service.description: A rich message from the current user (a member of a room that is not archived and not encrypted), or from an app (authorization disabled; senderUserId sends as another user, as send#Message). rich: {kind (text, card or carousel), text (a text's words), suggestions (a text's chips), cards [{title, description, attachmentSeq (its picture: the message's file of that place, 1 to n), suggestions}], providerContent {twilio: {contentSid, contentVariables}} (an app's own Twilio template, with authorization disabled only)}; a suggestion is {type: reply, text, postback} or {type: url, text, url} or {type: dial, text, phone}. A reply's postback is an app's own only with authorization disabled (never starting with "user:"); a member's is "user:" and its words. A card has its title or words and one thing more (the other, a picture or a button). chatAttachmentIdList: the cards' pictures, uploaded to the room (upload#Attachment), and no other files. Checked by normalize#Rich; its body is the fallback. threadRootEventSeq, clientRef and roomUrl as send#Message. Out: eventSeq, event (with rich), duplicate, reasonCode (encryptedRoom, badRich, badSuggestion, badImage, tooLong, notAllowed).

Internal: rich as send#Rich takes it, checked against the limits (ChatRich.js LIMITS) and cleaned (unknown keys dropped), with attachmentTypeList the content types of the message's files in order, and allowProviderContent. Out: rich, body (the fallback as safe HTML), fallbackText; or reasonCode and an error.

The current user (a member who may post) taps a reply of message eventSeq: suggestion index of card cardIndex, else of the message's chips. A message with its words is sent (in the message's thread), then note#SuggestionReply. Refused on one's own message (ownMessage), in a room with an outbound bridge (bridgedRoom: its buttons are the other person's), and for a link or a call (notReply). clientRef and roomUrl as send#Message. Out: eventSeq, event, reasonCode.

Internal: message eventSeq of room chatRoomId answers a suggestion: content.postback {data (postback, cut to 1024 characters), toEventSeq (the message whose button it was, when known)}, pushed to the room. From reply#Suggestion, and from SmsServices.receive#Sms for an RCS reply (chatBridgeId, no toEventSeq). An app that sent the buttons, with its own context in the postback (order:123:confirm), runs on a SECA of this service. The postback is untrusted (see the file's notes): before it acts, an app checks authorUserId (who wrote the tapped message) and fromApp (it was an app's, sent with authorization disabled); outside is an RCS reply, whose postback is the person's device's, unsigned. Out: postback ({data, toEventSeq, authorUserId, fromApp, outside}), authorUserId, fromApp, outside.
